data.narrative:
Slip Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) operating in the robotics and manufacturing sector. Key private peers include Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Divergent, and Exotec.

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses total raised ($44M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage progression, yielding $84M. The peer-median method triangulates off three directly comparable Series B robotics companies—Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B)—producing a median implied valuation of $1.8B and a range of $1.6B to $2.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range of $71M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $917M. The disparity reflects material uncertainty about whether Slip Robotics' capital efficiency and market position align with earlier-stage benchmarks or late-stage peer multiples. Resolution of this uncertainty requires deeper investigation into revenue trajectory, unit economics, and whether recent funding reflects genuine market validation or valuation inflation within the cohort. The stage-progression result anchors a conservative floor; peer-median reflects current market pricing but warrants scrutiny for sustainability.
